svg.title: PortableBlink breadboard: Arduino Uno
svg.text: PortableBlink on a breadboard: Arduino Uno
BUTTON on D2, RELAY on D7, STATUS on the on-board LED L (D13). Wire by the labels printed on the board.
The load goes on COM and NO.
The button's legs on the left (column 9) and right (column 11) are diagonally opposite, so the wiring works whichever way it is turned.
No resistors: the button uses the chip's internal pull-up, and the relay pin only pulls IN low or lets it go.
